name: Sokja
title: One Who Returned from Exile
summary: Sokja is mentioned in the book of Ezra as one of those who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem. He belonged to one of the families that participated in rebuilding the Jewish community after captivity. His name appears in the lists of returning exiles.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among Those Who Returned from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Sokja is mentioned among those who returned from the Babylonian exile to Judah and Jerusalem under the leadership of Zerubbabel.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding the Community in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: The returning families, including Sokja's descendants, contributed to rebuilding the Jewish community and the temple in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Registration of Lineages
keyEvents.description: The people were carefully registered according to their family lines to confirm their Jewish identity after returning from exile.

keyEvents.title: Assembly in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: The returned ones gathered as one people in Jerusalem to restore the worship of God and follow the Mosaic Law.
